'''Doom''' ({{G|Doom}}) is the [[Set bonus|intrinsic]] of [[Adamant equipment|adamant armor]]. Every three seconds it looks for creatures near the wearer that have {{MCW|Weakness}}, removes the Weakness, and deals damage that ignores armor. Each piece of adamant armor worn makes Doom stronger and wider, and the full set adds a bonus on top.

Doom pairs with the adamant weapons, which apply Weakness on every hit: the weapon marks a target, and the armor finishes it.

== Mechanics ==
=== Level ===
Each adamant armor piece the player wears raises their Doom level by 1, from 1 to 4. Only players count.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_armour.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/adamant_armour.mcfunction}}</ref> The tooltip shows {{G|Doom}} 3 on each piece and {{G|Doom set}} 4 as the set bonus, so a full set adds up to 3 × 4 + 4 = 16, which is the damage the full set deals.

=== Effect ===
{{Diagram|Doom|width=360|align=right|caption=Doom's reach with one to four pieces of adamant armor, drawn to scale; the numbers are blocks.}}
Every 3 seconds, for each player wearing adamant armor:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/3s/adamant_armour.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/adamant_effects/check_doom_4.mcfunction}}</ref>
# Every entity within the radius that has Weakness and is not wearing any adamant armor becomes a Doom target.
# If there is at least one target, a high-pitched raid omen sound plays at the player.
# Each target shows a burst of flame particles, takes damage and has its Weakness removed.

The damage is of the <code>out_of_world</code> type, so it ignores armor and {{MCW|Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/adamant_effects/apply_doom_4.mcfunction}}</ref>

Unlike [[warding]], Doom hits '''every''' target in range at once, not just the nearest.

=== Targets ===
Doom does not check the type of entity. Anything with Weakness in range is hit, including passive mobs, [[villager]]s and other players, as long as it isn't wearing an adamant armor piece.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/not_wearing_adamant.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/effects/has_weakness.json}}</ref> The wearer is never hurt by their own Doom, and adamant armor also protects other players from it. A {{MCW|Zombie Villager|zombie villager}} that has been given Weakness to be cured will be damaged by Doom, and its Weakness is removed.

Since removing the Weakness is part of the effect, each application of Weakness triggers Doom only once.

=== Applying Weakness ===
* The adamant weapons carry the {{G|Weakness}} intrinsic, which gives the target {{MCW|Weakness}} II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>
* Arrows of Weakness and other sources of Weakness work too. The developer noted that tipped weakness arrows are "a really useful thing now".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Yes, this means using tipped weakness arrows is a really useful thing now}}</ref>

{{History line|1.12.2|Added Doom, replacing adamant armor's earlier per-piece [[Divinity|divinity]] hearts. The release notes give {{G|Doom}} 3 as {{Hp|3}} and the full set's 16 as {{Hp|16}}.
The adamant weapon intrinsic now applies Weakness, and the adamant tool intrinsic smelts mined blocks.}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer wrote that Doom "fits Adamant's apocryphal title much more, and ties in with its hell-based theming".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=I think this fits Adamant's apocryphal title much more, and ties in with its hell-based theming}}</ref>
* The developer's plans include an advancement named ''Child of Moros'' for smithing the full adamant set.<ref>{{Cite changelog||quote=Child of Moros: Smith Full Adamant Set}}</ref>
